G1_execution_claim.caveat: It is appropriate to credit a reported GPU execution attempt, but not to assert 103 measured logits accuracy, confirmed forward count or mechanism discovery without raw artifact readback.

replay_verifier_code_audit.corrective_logic: Compares replay sample to primary plan_row, not to another replay as old buggy G1 V1 did. Uses identical float arrays and token_ids_sha256.
remaining_missing_explicit_assertions: all forward_index strictly unique and 1..103 in chronological order
exact role composition matches original frozen plan and user-approved budget
four replay rows reference four DISTINCT old baseline IDs
each replay's branch question IDs, key order and number of logits equal primary (zip alone silently truncates length mismatches)
pre-forward gate token rows/plan sha joined for each raw record, not just gate['status']==PASS
original V1 FAIL receipt and SHA immutable; corrected V2 does not overwrite its provenance
source G0 Gold and actual original pair_key corresponding to primary role audited in outcome analysis
primary GPU execution or V2 verifier actual run is archived with sha256 readback
replay_verifier_code_audit.conclusion: Verifier can correct a genuine false FAIL post hoc using persisted records, but code existence alone is not execution verification; it still needs full source-to-record checks before independent scientific confidence.

exact_state_cross_experiment.comparison: Remove the declared inserted state event from each G0 treatment input; compare canonical full JSON old state byte-equivalent (keys sorted) against each of 24 prior A428 original states.
exact_state_cross_experiment.important: The 30 G0 different old states correspond to 31 axis branches. Exactly one baseline was already subjected to A428 old FP32 pilot; baseline overlap is NOT the same thing as group overlap.

two_critical_veto_after_quorum.valid_inference_limit: Both are genuine new old states but re-use prior-pilot run groups; exploratory edge coverage, not source-group independent replication.
